title: Nice timer while it lasts, which isn't long
text: Nice timer while it lasts, which isn't long. This is a fairly decent timer, at least I thought for the few days it survived. The thing eats batteries! I replaced the batteries multiple times in the first month of owning only to have the timer not work within 2 days of replacing the batteries. I've spent more in batteries than on the timer, return period was up so I trashed it. Not worth it.
